context: A boss reviews a property-investment proposal
purpose: Teach: 月額/採決/取組/拠出/強行/承り/隊長/棟

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 新棟の月額賃料、収益見込みは?
lines.en: What's the monthly rent on the new building? Revenue projection?
lines.style: Measured opening. Sharp, business-ready tone. Clipped pace on each clause — no wasted breath. Eyes direct. This is the question underneath everything.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。隊長が現地視察を済ませ、強行的な値下げ要請は退けました。
lines.en: Yes. The team lead completed the site survey and held firm against the aggressive discounting.
lines.style: Straightforward report. Steady, confident delivery — no hedging. Each fact lands cleanly. Slight emphasis on 「拒けました」 to show the team did its job. Professional pride, quietly.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 拠出金の比率、再採決が必要だ。
lines.en: We need another vote on the contribution ratios.
lines.style: Directive but not harsh. Brief pause after 「比率」 — giving weight to the decision point. Calm assumption that this will happen. No inflection that asks permission.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: 取組チームに承りますと連絡し、今週中に再採決可能です。
lines.en: I'll notify the team now. We can get the revote done by end of week.
lines.style: Competent, no flourish. Direct statement of action and timeline. Slight forward lean in delivery — already moving on the task. Reliable without needing to announce it.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.style: Quiet gratitude. Slight exhale on the word — acknowledgment of effort, not dismissal. Warmth underneath the brevity. The kind of thanks that means something.
